module_summary: Six-state Moore FSM (A-F) stepping on input w, with output z decoded high in states E and F.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: 3-bit state register A..F, reset to A, next state chosen by w.

anchors.name: z
anchors.why: Moore output decoded from state, high in states E or F.

groups.name: fsm_controller
groups.description: Six-state Moore machine with next-state table on w and decoded output z.
